versions.changelog:
- Initial public release with 16 search engines (7 Chinese, 9 international).
- Modular codebase added: fusion_search.py (main), engines.py, router.py, scorer.py, stealth.js.
- Stealth anti-bot JavaScript included to enhance search engine reliability.
- Implements smart engine routing, automatic engine selection, result de-duplication, and quality scoring.
- Supports both CLI and Python API usage, with options for full content fetching and result filtering.
Initial release: 16 engine fusion search with Playwright stealth and intelligent routing
